Financial & Legal Disclaimer

The Short Version: ClarifyPost is an educational and informational platform. We are tech writers and researchers, not certified financial advisors, tax professionals, or legal experts. Nothing on this website should be interpreted as professional financial advice.

1. Educational Purposes Only

All content, articles, tutorials, and opinions published on ClarifyPost—including but not limited to topics covering cryptocurrency, the gig economy, high-yield savings accounts, and artificial intelligence—are intended solely for general informational and educational purposes.

The information provided does not address your specific individual circumstances, risk tolerance, or financial goals, and should not be relied upon to make personal financial or investment decisions.

2. No Professional Advice

The authors and publishers of ClarifyPost are not registered investment advisors, brokers, or certified public accountants (CPAs).

  • Do Your Own Research (DYOR): You must independently verify any information you find on this website.
  • Consult a Professional: Always consult with a licensed financial planner, tax advisor, or legal counsel before making any significant financial decisions, tax filings, or investments.

3. Investment and Cryptocurrency Risks

Investing in any asset class carries inherent risks, including the potential total loss of your principal investment.

  • Market Volatility: Digital assets, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Spot ETFs, and DeFAI (Decentralized Finance + AI) protocols, are highly volatile and speculative. Past performance is never a guarantee of future results.
  • AI and Automated Finance: Any discussions regarding "Agentic AI," algorithmic trading bots, or automated budgeting software are for educational exploration. Relying on experimental technology, third-party APIs, or automated agents to manage your wealth carries significant technical and financial risks.

4. Accuracy of Information

While we strive to ensure that all information published on ClarifyPost is accurate, thoroughly researched, and up-to-date at the time of publication, the technology and financial landscapes evolve rapidly. We make no representations or warranties of any kind, express or implied, about the absolute completeness, accuracy, reliability, or current suitability of the information, software, or services mentioned. Tax laws and platform rules can change without notice.

5. Affiliate and Advertising Disclosure

To keep this website free for our readers, ClarifyPost participates in affiliate marketing programs and displays third-party advertisements (such as Google AdSense).

  • Affiliate Links: We may earn a commission or referral fee if you click on certain links or purchase products/software recommended on our site, at absolutely no additional cost to you.
  • Editorial Independence: Our editorial content is strictly independent and is not influenced by advertisers or affiliate partnerships. We only write about and recommend tools, software, and methods that we genuinely believe provide value.

6. Limitation of Liability

Under no circumstances shall ClarifyPost, its owners, authors, or affiliates be held liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, or special damages arising out of or in connection with your use of this website or reliance on the information contained herein.
